# Sourdough

## Starter

Feed the starter 1:1:1 (starter, flour, water by weight) every 12 hours at room
temperature. It is ready when it doubles within 6 hours and passes the float
test.

## Basic loaf

- 500 g bread flour, 375 g water (75% hydration), 100 g active starter, 10 g salt.
- Autolyse flour and water for 1 hour before adding starter and salt.
- Four sets of stretch and folds, 30 minutes apart.
- Bulk ferment until the dough grows by half, shape, then cold retard overnight.
- Bake in a Dutch oven at 250 °C, 20 minutes covered and 25 uncovered.

## Notes from the café

The baker at the corner café suggested a crème fraîche glaze for a softer
crust. Worth one experiment.
